newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends weekly trading 2.08 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends weekly trading 2.08 pct higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market ended the week on Friday higher 2.08 percent with most stocks increasing in value compared with the previous session, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 503.36 points, up from 493.06 points, last Friday.
"Generally speaking the market stocks note a relative resumption of activity while the bourse index increased significantly since last week," a Casablanca-based trader said.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second largest private conglomerate which holds diversified stakes in more than 40 firms, gained 10 dirhams in one week to close at 604 dirhams.
The conglomerate has a market capitalisation of more than 5.6 billion dirhams.
In the banking sector, Banque Commerciale du Maroc, one of Morocco's largest banks, rose eight dirhams to close at 720 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a very competitive stock, was traded at 450 dirhams, up 30 dirhams from last week.
Samir oil refinery, the country's main refinery, gained 10 dirhams to close at 252 dirhams.
Main loser was newly-floated Credor which dipped 82 dirhams to close at 611 dirhams. it lost 82 dirhams in one week.
Traded volume on the official market was 48.7 million dirhams, up from 81.1 million last Friday.
